skillCheck.name: Skill check with GM confirmation
skillCheck.hint: The skill check window: skill, attribute and difficulty are chosen in one window (the "Test" button in Argon HUD opens it). Also the runFalloutCheck function for GM macros: a roll whose result the GM confirms.

rollEngine.name: Roll Engine (targets and hit location)
rollEngine.hint: Remembers the targets and hit location of an attack and passes them on to the damage roll.

difficulty.name: Difficulty Engine (difficulty and verdict)
difficulty.hint: Calculates roll difficulty, shows success or failure, adds Action Points.

damage.name: Damage Engine (damage)
damage.hint: Damage calculation and application, buttons on the chat card (GM only).

gmApproval.name: GM decision panel in chat
gmApproval.hint: Accept the roll, force a success or a failure, or cancel the action.

persistentDamage.name: Persistent damage
persistentDamage.hint: Automatically rolls damage from the Persistent effect at the end of the turn.

damageRules.name: Damage extra rules
damageRules.hint: Sneak attack (+2 CD for Vicious weapons, otherwise adds Vicious), the Big Leagues perk and blast miss (damage dice halved, effects cancelled). Replaces the world macro "2_Damage_extra_rules": disable that macro. Works together with the Difficulty Engine.

radiation.name: Radiation: effect and max HP
radiation.hint: When an actor's radiation changes, adds a "Radiation N" effect that lowers max HP by N, and cuts current HP down to the new maximum. Removes the effect when radiation drops to 0. Replaces the world macro "Radiation_for_NPCs": disable that macro. Also adds a "Radiation" field to NPC and creature sheets.

firstAid.name: First aid and repair
firstAid.hint: First aid (Medicine) and machine repair: checks, choice of medicine or kit, HP and injury treatment, stabilization. Started by the Argon HUD buttons and by the macro in the module compendium. Replaces the world macros "14_First_aid_button" and "17_Repair_button": disable them. Needs the "Skill check" block.

icon.hint: Path to an image. Leave empty to use the default Foundry icon.

ceRegister.name: Add effects to Convenient Effects
ceRegister.hint: If Convenient Effects has no Stunned, Persistent or Prone effect, the module adds it on startup. Existing CE effects are never changed or overwritten.

stun.name: Stunned
stun.description: The target cannot take their Standard actions on their next turn. A stunned character or creature can still spend AP to buy additional actions as normal.

skillCheck.speaker: Terminal System
skillCheck.rolled: Roll made. Waiting for the Overseer's response...
